record.original_question: Is there any finite term-rewriting system, of an appropriate kind, for free lattices?

evidence.quote: Is there a finite term-rewriting system of some kind for free lattices?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{FL}(X)$ denote the free lattice generated by a set $X$, regarded as an algebra in the signature $\{\vee, \wedge\}$ subject to the lattice axioms (idempotency, commutativity, associativity of both operations, and the two absorption laws). A term rewriting system over this signature (possibly modulo associativity and commutativity, or in some other suitable framework such as ordered, conditional, or graph rewriting) is called convergent if it is terminating and confluent, so that every term has a unique normal form. 

Question: Does there exist a finite term rewriting system, of some appropriate kind, that is convergent for the equational theory of lattices, so that the normal forms of terms over $X$ are in bijection with the elements of $\mathrm{FL}(X)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to remain open. Freese's expository writings on free lattices and on term rewrite systems for lattice theory note that, despite Whitman's canonical-form algorithm for the word problem in free lattices, no finite convergent (e.g. associative-commutative) term rewriting system for the equational theory of lattices is known, and the existence of one is still posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Term Rewrite Systems for Lattice Theory (Freese)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the absence of a known associative-commutative term rewriting system for free lattices despite Whitman's canonical form.
status_evidence.claim: No finite AC term rewrite system for free lattices is known; existence remains open.

status_evidence.title: Algorithms for Finite, Finitely Presented and Free Lattices (Freese)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of algorithms for free lattices including Whitman's canonical form algorithm.
status_evidence.claim: Whitman's algorithm solves the word problem but does not yield a finite TRS.

status_evidence.title: RTA List of Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Compiled list of open problems in rewriting including the lattice TRS question.
status_evidence.claim: The free-lattice TRS question is listed among open problems in rewriting.
